title: Detection of helminth ova genera using in-situ biosynthesis of gold nanoparticles
author: Ravindran, Truskewycz, et al.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M HAuCl₄ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve tetrachloroauric acid (HAuCl₄) obtained from Merck (Australia) in de‑ionised MilliQ water to a final concentration of 0.1 M.

steps.title: Isolate ova from faecal samples
steps.instruction: Process 5 g of infected pig faeces by adding magnesium sulphate (specific gravity 1.20) in 50 mL tubes, perform flotation, centrifuge twice at 800 g for 3 min, pass the supernatant through a 38 µm sieve, wash retained material with reverse‑osmosis water into a beaker, transfer to 15 mL tubes and centrifuge again at 800 g for 3 min; discard supernatant and keep the ova pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add MgSO₄ (SG 1.20) to 5 g faeces in each 50 mL tube.
Wash retained material with RO water into a small beaker.
Transfer wash to 15 mL tubes; centrifuge 800 g, 3 min.

steps.title: Enumerate ova by microscopy
steps.instruction: Resuspend the ova pellet and count ova using optical microscopy at ×200 magnification with Whitlock Universal 4‑chamber worm‑egg counting slides (J. A. Whitlock & Co, Australia), each chamber holding 500 µL.

steps.title: Store ova in potassium dichromate
steps.instruction: Aliquot approximately 1000 ± 20 ova of each helminth species into 1 mL of 5 % potassium dichromate in 2 mL Eppendorf tubes and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Set up gold reduction reaction
steps.instruction: Add 1000 ± 20 stored ova to 500 µL of 10 mM HAuCl₄ in separate tubes; prepare a control containing 500 µL of 10 mM HAuCl₄ without ova.

steps.title: Incubate reaction mixtures
steps.instruction: Place reaction tubes and control in a thermomixer (Eppendorf, Australia) set to 37 °C, 650 rpm, and incubate for 24 h.

steps.title: Observe colour change
steps.instruction: After incubation, visually inspect each tube for colour change indicating in‑situ AuNP synthesis.

steps.title: Perform SEM and EDX analysis
steps.instruction: Examine the ova‑AuNP samples with a Philips XL30 scanning electron microscope (Netherlands) and analyse elemental composition using an Oxford X‑Max20 EDX detector; maintain the electron beam at 15 keV for both imaging and EDX.

steps.title: Determine lower limit of detection
steps.instruction: Prepare reactions with 1, 10, 50, 100, 200 and 500 ova added to 500 µL of 10 mM HAuCl₄, incubate at 37 °C for 24 h in a thermomixer at 650 rpm, and assess the smallest ova number that yields a visible colour change.
